thread:
Lina (AE): HelixMed requested a performance plan + answers to sec questionnaire. goal: sustain 400 qps with p95 < 180ms for chat generate. can we run a test tomorrow morning?
Jon (SRE): yes. plan: smoke 40 qps, ramp to 400 qps over 10m, then 30m steady-state. will use k6 distributed across 2 regions.
Priya (Solutions Eng): workload mix: 70% short (<=48 tokens), 25% medium (49-200), 5% long. include KV cache warmup and a prewarm phase of 10m.
Lina (AE): Sec asks: do we support customer-managed KMS during POC and can logs be exported to their SIEM?
Marco (Security): we can do KMS via envelope keys for Private. Hosted can ship logs to their SIEM via secure syslog endpoint; need PO to enable retention >30d.
ProvisionerBot: provisioned test-api key helix-poc-202603, expires in 72h.
Jon (SRE): k6 command snippet: k6 run --vus 40 --duration 40m --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086 helix_chat.js. capturing p50/p95/p99, gpu_util, error_rate. dashboard link will be posted.
Priya (Solutions Eng): tuning note: reduce batch window from 12ms->6ms to improve p99 at cost of 8% throughput. enable prefix caching to reduce KV miss spikes.
Lina (AE): pricing ask: Helix wants hosted cost for the 30m soak and an upfront estimate for a 1-month Dedicated eval. include burst pricing for 2x sustained qps.
Priya (Solutions Eng): i'll provide token burn calc and two Dedicated configs (1x baseline, 2x burst) with monthly commit delta.
Jon (SRE): starting smoke now, will post quick metrics in ~8m. run-id=smoke-helix-01.
Jon (SRE): smoke10m results: p50 38ms, p95 150ms, p99 320ms, errors 0.3%. link: https://grafana.internal/d/POC/helix?panelId=4
Lina (AE): p95 ok, p99 high — pls include mitigation options in the writeup. i'll push the questionnaire answers to Helix after security signs off.
Marco (Security): i'll add KMS and log export wording and sign off; retention cost delta noted.
Priya (Solutions Eng): uploading final load plan + cost spreadsheet now.
Lina (AE): thanks team — aiming to send everything by EOD today. keep updates in this thread.
